caption: The video captures a horizontal row of thin vertical glass panes mounted upright in a wooden beam, set against a blurred backdrop of reddish rock and pale blue sky. The panes on the left are already shattered, with jagged shards hanging suspended and a dense white dust cloud filling the gaps, while the right-side panes remain clear and intact. Tiny bright particles scatter through the air above the broken section. The camera and background show little change, and no additional pane breaks appear. The white cloud slowly shifts shape and grows more diffuse at its edges, dispersing in place. The larger suspended shards remain nearly fixed, and the airborne specks drift and redistribute subtly. The overall state of destruction persists throughout.
